profile.headline: Systems Analyst / Software Engineer at O.C.Tanner
profile.summary:
Technical Background
Hardware /Software: I have 5+ years of professional experience providing Technical Support/Customer Service for Windows platforms including networking, updates, printing issues and more (Win 95, win98, Win Me, Win XP, Win 2000, Win Vista, and personal experience with Win 7.  I have 2+ years of Basic experience with Linux OS and Fedora web servers, and Mac OS.
 
Programming / Web Development: I have a good understanding of Object Oriented programming. I have 3+ years of experience on web Development, familiarity using MVC architecture. I’m proficient at creating, maintaining, and editing documents in the following programming languages: HTML, CSS, XML, JS, ASP, .NET, C#, SQL, PHP, Flash AS 3.0, Silver light among other languages. 
 
Managerial Skills:
I take pleasure in working independently as well as in teams. I possess the ability to coordinate individuals, and work well under pressure. I enjoy documenting all my work with attention to details. I enjoy motivating and mentoring others to achieve mutual success. Prioritizing while multi-tasking is my strategy to successful and timely complete projects.  
 
Office Skills:
I’m computer literate, and highly proficient with software applications like, word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, e-mail, databases, project management, and document control. 
 
Personality Traits
I’m self motivated, enthusiastic, creative, and well organized. I’m bilingual (English/Spanish) and I possess good oral and written communication skills. I' have a passion about learning new methods and technologies, and combined with my interpersonal and problem-solving skills.

positions.title: Systems Analyst / Software Engineer
positions.description:
O.C. Tanner is the world’s largest recognition company, providing career achievement, performance and recognition solutions for many of the world’s most admired companies, including 29 of the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® (OCTanner being one of them).

As a Systems Analyst, I'm Responsible for coordinating IT projects with VPs, Departments, Manufacturing teams, IT staff and Vendors with particular emphasis to assist the Supply Chain. 

Here are a few of the responsibilities I have been able to help while at the company:
Jira Administrator(Atlassian), Confluence Administrator(Atlassian), SAP Configurator, Sharepoint Administrator (Microsoft), WMS Administrator (HighJump Software), Box.com admin, Production Control Manager, and other strategic roles.  
As a Software Engineer, I have developed multiple homegrown internal Apps: QED App (Quality Efficiency and Delivery), Track.octanner.io, Outlet.octanner.io, Trends.octanner.io, wms.octanner.io, Infor.octanner.io, Thanks.octanner.io, BOM.octanner.io, SCS.octanner.io, AwardStream.octanner.io, and countless reports.

We use the Agile Methodology, and Lean Principles.

positions.title: Business Owner
positions.description: EGM Solutions was founded on 2006 in response to the increasing need for digital solutions to web and multimedia demands. I created EGMzone.com, a website to expand my services to national and even international clients. EGM Solutions specializes on web development.

positions.description: Travel to Area Stores and lead team members to set seasonal displays. Trainer

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description: Create, Edit and maintain the company's websites. I created & launched a new Commercial website. I was responsible to manage E-commerce, reports, stats, sales, and other multiple web accounts, including the very well-known WillItBlend.com viral campaign. During my time at Blendtec, web sales substantially increased in collaboration with the Marketing Team.
